title: QuantReflex Question
description: Canonical schema for questions in the QuantReflex ecosystem. Used by both the Admin Panel (write) and Main App (read). Stored in Firestore 'questions' collection.

type.description: Question type. Currently only 'word_problem' is supported.

topic.description: Topic category key. Uses underscore_case in Admin Panel (e.g., 'profit_loss'). The Main App normalizes both hyphen-case and underscore_case.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level. Main App uses this for filtering and intelligent fallback.

question.description: The question text displayed to the student.

options.description: Optional MCQ options. Empty array for open-answer questions.

explanation.description: Step-by-step explanation of the solution. Displayed after the student answers.

approved.description: Whether the question has been approved by an admin. Must be true for active questions.

status.description: Publication status. Only 'active' questions are served to students.

premiumOnly.description: If true, this question is only available to Premium/Premium+ users.
